creators: B. S. Sharmila and Rohini Nagapadma
scope: Captured IoT testbed traffic with generated attacks; not enterprise access-decision ground truth.
ordering: No capture timestamps in the released CSV. Evaluation uses explicitly constructed replay order; no claim of natural chronological concept drift.

protocol.split: Known families: stratified 60% train, 20% validation, 20% test. Novel families: exclusively test.
protocol.selection: Model selected by known-family validation log loss; no test data used in training, scaling, canonical anchors or threshold choice.
protocol.feedback: Test-then-train, labels revealed only after each 32-record batch; this is a simulated oracle-label assumption.
protocol.shifted: Four replay phases: known / novel / known / novel attack families. Held-out benign rows distributed across all phases; each record used once.
protocol.unit: One measured bidirectional flow; this backend is not a temporal LSTM.
protocol.duplicates: Exact deployed-feature vectors deduplicated BEFORE splitting; binary-label conflicts excluded.
